device: CPU float64 and float32; checkpoint initially loaded on MPS bfloat16
reason: Diagnose whether the failed absolute fp32 1e-5 gate is arithmetic rounding or a channel/temporal/packing error; the hypothesis is unproven.

input.gray: torch manual_seed(0), randn [1,120,120], bicubic 112x112, replicate 3 or 12 channels and both temporal frames; Qwen packed C,T,14,14
input.real_input: frozen-contract normalized float32 [12,120,120], bicubic pack to 112x112, cast to float64 for analytic projection; m is mean over 12 channel dimension for each temporal/spatial element

weight_cast: Load pinned checkpoint as bfloat16 as in loop 4; cast the same vision weights to CPU float64 for fp64 reference and to CPU float32 for noise-floor checks. Compute 12-channel initialization independently in each dtype using the unchanged conversion utility.

gates.fp32_noise_floor_rule: max_abs(new32 - old64 reference) <= 3 * max_abs(old32 - old64 reference), separately for projection and full vision

verdict_rule: Proceed to original loop-4 forward and tiny overfit only if all fp64 gray, real analytic, and fp32 noise-floor gates pass. Otherwise stop; do not change original result, initialization or thresholds.
resource_rule: If full fp64 vision tower cannot run within available RAM, stop and report; do not reduce the model or input silently.
